summary: Agent-centric social layer: agents hold perspectives (local link graphs), express signed data, and share perspectives in neighbourhoods via pluggable languages. This is a small placeholder until the extracted model lands.

concepts.name: Agent
concepts.summary: A sovereign identity (a DID) that authors and signs everything.

concepts.name: Expression
concepts.summary: A piece of signed, authored, timestamped data.

concepts.name: Language
concepts.summary: A pluggable module defining how a kind of expression is created, stored and shared.

concepts.name: Perspective
concepts.summary: An agent's local graph of links — its view of the world.

concepts.name: Neighbourhood
concepts.summary: A shared perspective — a p2p space where agents sync links via a link-language.

threads.name: Publish a link into a neighbourhood
threads.summary: How a link written locally reaches peers.

threads.name: Create a signed expression
threads.summary: How authored data becomes verifiable expression.
